# Hooks

The query hook that restricts or extends the statement behind a field.

## `QueryHook` {#strawchemy-transpiler-hook-QueryHook}

[source](https://github.com/gazorby/strawchemy/blob/v0.24.0/src/strawchemy/transpiler/hook.py#L54)

```python
QueryHook(load: Sequence[LoadType] = _UnsetLoad()) -> None
```

Loads extra columns and relations, or edits the SELECT, for the type, field or repository it is attached to.

Override ``apply_hook`` to edit the statement; read the current request from ``info``.

### `apply_hook` {#strawchemy-transpiler-hook-QueryHook-apply_hook}

```python
apply_hook(statement: Select[tuple[DeclarativeT]], alias: AliasedClass[DeclarativeT]) -> Select[tuple[DeclarativeT]]
```

Returns ``statement`` edited, for instance with a filter or a join; unchanged by default.

``alias`` is the alias of the model the hook runs on: the related model for a relation field.

### `check_model` {#strawchemy-transpiler-hook-QueryHook-check_model}

```python
check_model(model: type[DeclarativeBase]) -> None
```

Checks that the top-level attributes of ``load`` can be loaded from ``model``.

**Raises:**

Type | Description
---- | -----------
<code>QueryHookError</code> | If an attribute belongs neither to ``model`` nor to a model it inherits from.

### `column_load_options` {#strawchemy-transpiler-hook-QueryHook-column_load_options}

```python
column_load_options(alias: AliasedClass[Any]) -> list[_AbstractLoad]
```

Returns ``undefer`` options for the columns in ``load``, read from ``alias``.

### `info` {#strawchemy-transpiler-hook-QueryHook-info}

```python
info: Info[Any, Any]
```

Strawberry ``Info`` of the current request.

**Raises:**

Type | Description
---- | -----------
<code>QueryHookError</code> | If no request is being resolved.

### `info_var` {#strawchemy-transpiler-hook-QueryHook-info_var}

```python
info_var: ContextVar[Info[Any, Any] | None] = ContextVar("info", default=None)
```

Strawberry ``Info`` of the current request.

### `load` {#strawchemy-transpiler-hook-QueryHook-load}

```python
load: Sequence[LoadType] = field(default_factory=_UnsetLoad)
```

Columns and relations to load, a relation with its own list.

Example: ``[User.name, (User.addresses, [Address.street])]``

### `load_columns` {#strawchemy-transpiler-hook-QueryHook-load_columns}

```python
load_columns(statement: Select[tuple[DeclarativeT]], alias: AliasedClass[Any], mode: ColumnLoadingMode) -> tuple[Select[tuple[DeclarativeT]], list[_AbstractLoad]]
```

Loads the columns in ``load``, as ``undefer`` options or, in ``"add"`` mode, as selected columns.

### `load_relationships` {#strawchemy-transpiler-hook-QueryHook-load_relationships}

```python
load_relationships(alias: AliasedClass[Any]) -> list[_AbstractLoad]
```

Returns the loader options of the relations in ``load``, loaded from ``alias``.
